name: Harborview 3-Seat Sofa
description: A deep three-seat sofa with feather-wrapped foam cushions, a kiln-dried hardwood frame and tapered oak legs. Loose back cushions can be fluffed and rotated.

name: Alder Compact Loveseat
description: A narrow two-seat loveseat built for small apartments and reading nooks. Tight back, firm seat, removable machine-washable covers.

name: Rill Modular Corner Sectional
description: A five-piece modular sectional that reconfigures into an L or a U. Stain-resistant performance fabric intended for households with pets and children.

name: Fenwick Swivel Armchair
description: A fully rotating armchair on a matte black disc base, with a curved channel-tufted back and a shallow seat that suits shorter sitters.

name: Post Ergonomic Desk Chair
description: A breathable mesh task chair with adjustable lumbar support, 4D armrests and a synchro-tilt mechanism. Rated for eight-hour workdays.

name: Ives Stackable Dining Chair
description: A lightweight stackable side chair in bent plywood with a steel rod frame. Stacks six high for storage between dinner parties.

name: Kestrel Extending Dining Table
description: Seats six, or eight with the self-storing butterfly leaf extended. Hand-finished with a matte hardwax oil that can be spot-repaired.

name: Marlow Round Bistro Table
description: A 30-inch round cafe table with a honed marble top and a weighted pedestal base that resists tipping.

name: Selby Lift-Top Coffee Table
description: The top lifts and slides forward to become a laptop or dining surface, with a hidden compartment underneath for remotes and chargers.

name: Nord Standing Desk
description: A dual-motor sit-stand desk with four memory presets, travelling from 25 to 51 inches. Integrated cable tray along the rear edge.

name: Ashford Upholstered Platform Bed
description: A low platform bed with a tall wingback headboard and sprung slats, so no box spring is required. Available queen and king.

name: Tamm Storage Bed
description: Four deep drawers on soft-close runners built into the base, replacing a dresser in rooms without closet space.

name: Junia Bunk Bed
description: A twin-over-twin bunk with a full-length guardrail and an angled ladder. Separates into two standalone beds as children grow.

name: Kettle 5-Shelf Bookcase
description: An open bookcase with three adjustable shelves and an anti-tip wall strap included. Holds roughly 150 hardcovers.

name: Wren 6-Drawer Dresser
description: A wide six-drawer dresser with dovetailed solid-wood drawer boxes and full-extension runners.

name: Halden Entryway Bench with Hooks
description: A hall tree combining a seat, two shoe cubbies and five cast-iron coat hooks for narrow entry halls.

name: Pell Media Console
description: A 65-inch console with cane-front cabinet doors, rear cable pass-throughs and a ventilated bay for a receiver.

name: Sarai Hand-Knotted Wool Rug
description: A hand-knotted wool rug with a faded medallion pattern and a dense low pile that hides everyday traffic.

name: Cove Flatweave Indoor-Outdoor Rug
description: A reversible flatweave rug that can be hosed down and left to dry, suitable for covered porches and high-spill dining areas.

name: Muir Washable Runner
description: A low-profile 2-by-8 runner with a non-slip backing that fits in a household washing machine.

name: Orbit Arc Floor Lamp
description: A sweeping arc lamp with a marble base that reaches over a sofa without a ceiling fixture. Dimmable, bulb not included.

name: Pike Adjustable Task Lamp
description: A clamp-mounted task lamp with a weighted swing arm and a warm-to-cool colour temperature dial for evening work.

name: Halo Linear Pendant
description: A 48-inch linear pendant with three opal globes, sized to hang over a six-seat dining table. Adjustable cable drop.

name: Ferry Teak Patio Dining Set
description: A six-seat outdoor dining set in untreated teak that weathers to a silver-grey, with slatted tops that shed rain.

name: Cinder Fire Pit Table
description: A propane fire pit table with a hidden tank compartment and a lid that converts it into a low outdoor coffee table.

name: Lark Folding Balcony Bistro Set
description: A two-chair and table set that folds flat for winter storage in a small apartment balcony or fire escape.

name: Drift Hybrid Mattress
description: A 12-inch hybrid with individually wrapped coils and a gel foam comfort layer, medium-firm. Motion isolation suits couples with different schedules.

name: Loam Memory Foam Mattress
description: An all-foam mattress that sleeps soft and contours closely, favoured by side sleepers with shoulder or hip pressure.

name: Bramble Blackout Curtains
description: A pair of blackout panels that block most daylight and dampen street noise, useful for shift workers and nurseries.

name: Quill Arched Wall Mirror
description: A tall arched mirror with a thin black frame that visually widens narrow hallways. Ships with a French cleat.
